Bill.BriefDescription: Removing provisions relating to subversive activities.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35A.42.020 and 1967 ex.s. c 119 s 35A.42.020 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as otherwise provided in this title, every elective andappointive officer and all employees of code cities shall: (1) Bepossessed of the qualifications and be subject to forfeiture of office,impeachment or removal and recall as provided in chapter 42.04 RCW((and RCW 9.81.040)); and (2) provide official bonds in accordance withthe requirements of this title, and as required in compliance withchapters 42.08 and 48.28 RCW. When vacancies in public offices in code cities shall occur theterm of a replacement officer shall be fixed as provided in chapter42.12 RCW. A public officer charged with misconduct as defined inchapter 42.20 RCW, shall be charged and, upon conviction, punished asprovided for such misconduct in chapter 42.20 RCW. The officers and p. 1 HB 1062employees of code cities shall be guided and governed by the code ofethics as provided in chapter 42.23 RCW. Vouchers for the payment ofpublic funds and the provisions for certifying the same shall be asprovided in chapter 42.24 RCW. The meetings of any board, agency, orcommission of a code city shall be open to the public to the extent andnotice given in the manner required by chapter 42.32 RCW.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 9.81.010 (Definitions) and 1953 c 142 s 1 & 1951 c 254 s 1; RCW 9.81.020 (Subversive activities made felonyPenalty) and2003 c 53 s 44 & 1951 c 254 s 2; RCW 9.81.030 (Membership in subversive organization is felonyPenalty) and 2003 c 53 s 45 & 1951 c 254 s 3; RCW 9.81.040 (Disqualification from voting or holding publicoffice) and 1951 c 254 s 4; RCW 9.81.050 (Dissolution of subversive organizationsDisposition of property) and 1951 c 254 s 5; RCW 9.81.060 (Public employmentSubversive person ineligible)and 1951 c 254 s 11; RCW 9.81.070 (Public employmentDetermining eligibilityInquiriesOath) and 1955 c 377 s 1 & 1951 c 254 s 12; RCW 9.81.080 (Public employmentInquiries may be dispensedwith, when) and 1955 c 377 s 2 & 1951 c 254 s 13; RCW 9.81.082 (Membership in subversive organization described)and 1955 c 377 s 3; RCW 9.81.083 (Communist party declared a subversiveorganization) and 1955 c 377 s 4; RCW 9.81.090 (Public employeesDischarge of subversivepersonsProcedureHearingAppeal) and 2011 c 336 s 328, 1971 c 81 s44, & 1951 c 254 s 15; RCW 9.81.110 (Misstatements are punishable as perjuryPenalty) and 1951 c 254 s 17; and RCW 9.81.120 (Constitutional rightsCensorship orinfringement) and 1951 c 254 s 19.
